protocol.split: fixed (train raws2,raws3,rawos1,rawos2,rawos4 = 192 frames; val raws1,rawos3 = 75 frames)

source_prior.label: SynWoodScape pretrain (adapted)
source_prior.note: cropped and resampled to the target task's cell size

source_prior_native.label: SynWoodScape pretrain (native)
source_prior_native.note: the source's own 30 m coverage at a driving-standard cell size

statistics.rule: two-sided paired t-test over seeds (df = n-1); significant iff the 95% confidence interval of the mean paired difference excludes 0
statistics.multiple_comparisons: each metric tested separately, no correction

caveats: the native-geometry labels have no manual refinement -- the refined labels exist only at ROI 8/4/+-6, so the gap against the adapted arm mixes geometry with label quality
the SynWoodScape BEV is a pinhole view from 15 m, not an orthographic projection; a surface at height h is magnified by 15/(15-h)
